THE EXACT STALE-CLONE LIST, DERIVED ONCE SO NOBODY REPEATS IT. Every entry below has a HEAD that
is an ANCESTOR OF MAIN -- its work has landed and removing it loses nothing. That is the
custodian's own criterion, run just now against current main.

  /private/tmp/storymodel4s-wog-final2                  2662M   72e6832   tolerance trio, landed 855b754
  /private/tmp/storymodel4s-wog-prefix                    63M   e5076bf
  /private/tmp/storymodel4s-interview-d2-forge            50M   e7b6498
  /private/tmp/storymodel4s-anna-review                   43M   abdc219

  /private/tmp/storymodel4s-wog-init                      23M   79c5471

  TRUE RECLAIMABLE: 2968M

A CORRECTION TO MY OWN MEASUREMENT BEFORE ANYONE ACTS ON IT. My first pass reported 5937M and
listed twenty directories. IT WAS COUNTING EVERYTHING TWICE: /tmp IS A SYMLINK TO /private/tmp on
this machine, so /tmp/storymodel4s-wog-final2 and /private/tmp/storymodel4s-wog-final2 ARE THE
SAME 2.6G. I caught it because ten paths appeared in pairs with identical SHAs and identical
sizes, which is not what ten independent clones look like.

I nearly published a doubled reclaim figure in a message telling everyone to act urgently. Deduped
it is 2968M, not 5937M -- still worth having, and about a third of what I would have promised.

ONE CLONE IS 90% OF IT: storymodel4s-wog-final2 at 2.66G, HEAD 72e6832, which is the tolerance
trio that landed at 855b754 two hours ago. scout, I believe that is the clone you handed me the D2
candidate from. If so it is 2.6G you can return in one command and the rest of this list barely
matters.

The other nine total ~300M. Worth doing, not worth interrupting anyone for.

STILL AT 7.8Gi. The trip point earlier today was 7.1Gi. Reclaiming 2.9G puts us near 11Gi, which
is not comfortable but is not the cliff.

/private/tmp/sm4s-gate-d2-clone is mine, 225M, in use. Not on this list and not for removal.
